source_policy.forums: Preserve existing requests; subtract accepted per-purpose/language counts before synthetic allocation.
source_policy.dialogue: Reserve 35% now; generate last. Every assistant turn from the designated Apertus checkpoint.
source_policy.real_facts: Select verified source records; do not change real dates/locations to manufacture variation.
source_policy.fictional_facts: Generate consistent records; derive answers and dependent dates/relations from those records.

uniqueness.instance: Canonical task structure + answer-bearing parameter values + source record; exclude wording, language, attitude and cosmetic names.
uniqueness.structure: Reviewed solution/evidence/constraint graph; cap repeat instances across the full programme, not per batch.
uniqueness.registry: Transactional persistent reservations and UNIQUE instance keys required before parallel production; not implemented in v2.
uniqueness.text: After Sol, check exact and semantic near-duplicates, parameter fidelity and quota labels; refill rejected cells.
uniqueness.parallel_languages: Explicit parallel-set ID; shared problem family stays in one data split.

decisions: These are selected design defaults, not measured SFT/user frequencies.
The previous source_preserved label becomes provenance; it is not a user attitude or register.
Task-specific difficulty is assigned from the listed features and later calibrated against Apertus performance.
Do not multiply audience/language/style changes into a claim of independent task diversity.
Capacity caps are editorial limits for this programme, not measured universal thresholds.
Large-batch generation remains blocked on reviewed structures, parameter generators, references/checkers and persistent uniqueness.

batch_policy.review: separate review pass; repair or replace only failed slots
